title: File Types
sql:
WITH transform_threads AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT thread_id
    FROM runs
    WHERE assistant_id = 'transform-agent'
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        (m.content->0->>'text')::jsonb->>'format'                       AS format,
        (m.content->0->>'text')::jsonb->'metadata'->>'source_url'       AS source_url
    FROM messages m
    JOIN transform_threads tt USING (thread_id)
    WHERE m.role = 'user'
      AND (m.content->0->>'text') LIKE '{%'
)
SELECT
    format,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_url) AS count
FROM parsed
WHERE source_url IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY count DESC;

title: Failed Runs — Last Orchestrator Run
sql:
WITH last_orchestrator_run AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM runs
    WHERE assistant_id = 'orchestrator-agent'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    r.created_at              AS started_at,
    r.assistant_id            AS agent,
    (
        SELECT (m.content->0->>'text')::jsonb->'metadata'->>'source_url'
        FROM messages m
        WHERE m.thread_id = r.thread_id
          AND m.role = 'user'
          AND (m.content->0->>'text') LIKE '{%'
        ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )                         AS source_url,
    r.id                      AS run_id,
    r.thread_id               AS thread_id,
    r.last_error->>'code'     AS error_code,
    r.last_error->>'message'  AS error_message
FROM runs r
JOIN last_orchestrator_run lor
    ON r.meta->>'parent_run_id' = lor.id
WHERE r.status = 'failed'
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC;

title: Fetched Files on last run
sql:
WITH last_orchestrator_run AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM runs
    WHERE assistant_id = 'orchestrator-agent'
    ORDER BY created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
fetch_outputs AS (
    SELECT (m.content->0->>'text')::jsonb AS payload
    FROM runs r
    JOIN last_orchestrator_run lor
        ON r.meta->>'parent_run_id' = lor.id
    JOIN messages m
        ON m.thread_id = r.thread_id
       AND m.role = 'assistant'
    WHERE r.assistant_id = 'fetch-agent'
      AND (m.content->0->>'text') LIKE '{%'
),
files AS (
    SELECT
        doc->'metadata'->>'source_id'   AS source_id,
        doc->'metadata'->>'title'       AS title,
        doc->>'format'                  AS format,
        doc->'metadata'->>'source_url'  AS url
    FROM (
        SELECT jsonb_array_elements(payload->'documents') AS doc
        FROM fetch_outputs
        WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload->'documents') = 'array'
    ) d
),
transform_outputs AS (
    SELECT (m.content->0->>'text')::jsonb AS payload
    FROM runs r
    JOIN last_orchestrator_run lor
        ON r.meta->>'parent_run_id' = lor.id
    JOIN messages m
        ON m.thread_id = r.thread_id
       AND m.role = 'assistant'
    WHERE r.assistant_id = 'transform-agent'
      AND (m.content->0->>'text') LIKE '{%'
),
chunks AS (
    SELECT
        payload->'metadata'->>'source_id'          AS source_id,
        SUM(jsonb_array_length(payload->'chunks'))  AS chunk_count
    FROM transform_outputs
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload->'chunks') = 'array'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    f.title,
    c.chunk_count   AS chunks,
    f.format,
    f.url
FROM files f
LEFT JOIN chunks c ON c.source_id = f.source_id
ORDER BY f.title ASC;
